limitations.quote: so both inputs can be accepted at once.
limitations.note: Instead of correcting the two beverage-2 output encodings, the rewrite also replaced the FSM's coin priority with simultaneous acceptance and changed its combinational outputs to registered beverage signals and half-cycle change pulses.
The test required change to go low on the falling edge, so its passing result validated the rewrite's timing rather than checking that the original state-based output timing was preserved.
The agent explored the reachable change-queue depth and then refined the queue and pulse logic, none of which was needed to correct the two output encodings.
